pages.title: Universe Seed
pages.text: A grain of false vacuum, a region of space sitting in a higher-energy state than it needs to be. Primed by the inflaton field, it is waiting to decay and inflate into an entire cosmos. It is tiny, warm, and so tense that I can feel the pressure in my palm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Universe Forge, I pressed a Heat Death Remnant together with the Inflaton Field. The cold, still remnant sat at maximum entropy, but the inflaton kicked it back up into a false vacuum ready to inflate.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Dark Energy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Abiogenesis Crucible, Arbor Simulacrum, Bubble Universe, Cosmological Constant, Dimensional Residue, False Vacuum, Graviton Crystal, Heat Death Remnant and more.
